name: MLS(ASCP) / MLS(ASCPi) certification
body: American Society for Clinical Pathology Board of Certification (ASCP BOC)
format: Per secondary sources: 100 multiple-choice questions, 2 h 30 min, computer adaptive testing. NOT verified against the official guideline in this build.

outline.title: MLS(ASCP) Examination Content Guideline (official PDF)
outline.verificationNote: The official PDF returned HTTP 403/404 from the build environment on 2026-10-07, so content areas and weights below come from secondary summaries and are UNVERIFIED. Two secondary summaries disagreed on Microbiology (17–20% vs 17–22%). Download the current guideline from ascp.org and update this file.

outline.title: Reviewer Appendix A — ASCP BOC exam-blueprint coverage map
outline.verificationNote: The reviewer states Blood Banking, Chemistry, Hematology and Microbiology at 17–22% each and Urinalysis/Body Fluids, Immunology and Laboratory Operations at 5–10% each, and treats molecular chapters (67–79) as cross-cutting. This is the reviewer's statement, not the official guideline; still awaiting the official ASCP PDF.

outline.title: MLS(ASCPi) international guideline
outline.verificationNote: Not checked. ASCPi has its own content guideline; confirm whether its areas and weights differ from the US MLS guideline before relying on this track for ASCPi.

trackOnlyNotes: Molecular diagnostics (reviewer Part VIII, Ch. 67–79) is cross-cutting per the reviewer — distributed across Laboratory Operations, Blood Banking and Immunology. Not given its own weight.
Education principles (ASCP Laboratory Operations) are not covered by the reviewer — listed as a gap domain.

name: Philippine Medical Technologist Licensure Examination (MTLE)
body: Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) — Professional Regulatory Board of Medical Technology
format: Written examination (R.A. 5527, Sec. 15). Passing as enacted: general average ≥75% with no subject below 50% (Sec. 19) — confirm current PRC rules.

outline.title: R.A. No. 5527 (Philippine Medical Technology Act of 1969), Sec. 17 — Scope of Examination
outline.verificationNote: Read 2026-10-07. Sec. 17 lists subjects and relative weights (below) and allows the Board to change subjects or weights with approval.

outline.title: PRB of Medical Technology Resolution No. 13, s. 2023 — Enhanced Tables of Specifications
outline.verificationNote: Resolution text read 2026-10-07: adopts the enhanced TOS (Annex A) from the August 2023 MTLE onward and supersedes Res. No. 12 s. 2009. Annex A itself (topics, item counts, current weights) was NOT retrieved — prc.gov.ph returned HTTP 403. Topic lists in this app are therefore not TOS-verified.

areas.name: Clinical Microscopy (Urinalysis and other body fluids)
Histopathologic Technique (current scope per secondary sources also includes cytology, MT laws, laboratory management and ethics)
areas.note: 10% weight from R.A. 5527 Sec. 17. The reviewer has NO histopathology/cytology chapters and no Philippine law chapters (gap domains). Its Ch. 13–14 (lab business, ethics) are US/general in scope. Expanded subject scope unverified pending Annex A.

trackOnlyNotes: Weights are from R.A. 5527 as enacted (1969). The Board may change them; confirm against Annex A of Res. 13 s. 2023.

The reviewer is ASCP-oriented (its Appendix A maps only to the ASCP blueprint). US-specific content (CLIA, Medicare billing, FDA, OSHA, AABB) may not match Philippine regulations — PH equivalents are not covered.
Molecular diagnostics, lab math and QC are not separate MTLE subjects; reviewer chapters on them are tagged to both tracks as supporting content (mapping unverified).
